_note: Prewritten bilingual sentences for Piper TTS and for the screens. The LLM picks a sentence id, not free text. Free LLM text is never spoken. English and Chinese, one id per sentence.

en.approval_pending: Approval pending. Press green to approve, red to reject.
en.choose_scenario: Choose scenario. Green is 2020. Red is 2022.
en.did_not_understand: I did not understand. Please say it again.
en.press_green_to_resume: Kill released. Press green once to resume.
en.proposal_received: Proposal received. Press green to approve, red to reject.
en.reject_proposed: Reject proposed. Press red to confirm.
en.software_freeze: Software freeze on. The physical kill switch is the real stop.
